definitions.explanation: Staying somewhere for one night, typically at a hotel or inn.

examples.japanese: {一泊|いっぱく}いくらですか。
examples.english: How much is it for one night?

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}で{一泊|いっぱく}した。
examples.english: I stayed one night at a hot spring inn.

examples.japanese: {一泊|いっぱく}{二|に}{日|にち}の{旅行|りょこう}に{出|で}かけた。
examples.english: I went on a one-night, two-day trip.

notes:
{一泊|いっぱく} is used when counting overnight stays at accommodations.

COMMON ACCOMMODATION TERMS:
- {一泊|いっぱく}{二|に}{日|にち}: one night, two days (standard short trip)
- {一泊|いっぱく}{二|に}{食|しょく}（{付|つ}き）: one night with two meals (dinner and breakfast)
- {一泊|いっぱく}{朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き: one night with breakfast
- {一泊|いっぱく}{素泊|すどま}り: one night, room only (no meals)

BOOKING EXPRESSIONS:
- {一泊|いっぱく}○○{円|えん}: ○○ yen per night
- {一泊|いっぱく}{予約|よやく}する: to book for one night

RELATED COUNTERS:
- {二泊|にはく}: two nights
- {三泊|さんぱく}: three nights
- {何泊|なんぱく}: how many nights
